name: Screen
description: Capture screenshots of the host screen.
author: PAI

capabilities.description: Take a screenshot of the whole desktop and save it as a PNG. Uses the desktop's screenshot portal (GNOME, KDE), or grim / scrot where that is all there is. Returns the file path and the image width and height. Requires the screen permission.
capabilities.confirmationReason: Capturing screenshots can be sensitive. Please confirm that you want to take a screenshot.

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the PNG. Defaults to ~/Pictures/PAI/screen_<timestamp>.png

changelog.summary: Screenshots now work on GNOME and KDE Wayland, through the desktop's screenshot portal.
features: screen.capture uses the XDG desktop portal first, so it works where grim does not (GNOME's compositor has no wlr-screencopy)
screen.capture reports the image width and height (needed to place mouse clicks)
fixes: A declined or unanswered permission dialog is reported as capture_denied / capture_timeout instead of silently trying another tool
A tool that exits successfully without producing a PNG is reported as capture_invalid
Screenshots are saved readable by the owner only (0600)
